title: Leakage-Controlled Shisper Glacier 30-Day Lake-Drainage Benchmark with Calendar Controls
description: Reproducibility release for a leakage-controlled 30-day lake-drainage benchmark at Shisper Glacier. It contains the frozen causal30_v1 evidence, calendar-only controls, model and ablation summaries, anchor-level predictions, excluded-anchor records, verification scripts, checksums and explicit interpretation boundaries.
